segments.contextAfter: **Note**: [`Transaction`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SwiftUI/Transaction) isn’t available to widgets and Live Activities, so you can’t cancel or deactivate an animation by setting the transaction’s [`animation`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SwiftUI/Transaction/animation) property to `nil`.
